name: qa-factory
description: QA Factory: ticket-driven functional testing with two human gates. qa-onboarding learns a repository once, qa-story takes a ticket from context and grounding through plan, cases, automation, quiet runs and triage to a code-computed checks ledger before any MR; qa-doctor reports one next action.
skillInstructions: Entry points: qa-story is the primary entry point for ticket-driven QA — it takes a ticket from grounding to a checks ledger and, on the human's decision, an MR. Run qa-onboarding once per repository before any story. qa-doctor verifies the setup and shows where the current story is.

interface.shortDescription: Ticket-driven QA factory with two human gates
interface.longDescription: Learns a repository once (qa-onboarding), then drives every ticket through grounding, a risk-based plan with an explicit disposition per row, test cases, automation with a code critic, quiet test runs, triage with evidence and a code-computed checks ledger the human sees before deciding on an MR. qa-doctor verifies the setup and names one next action.
